summary: kubeflow is a Kubernetes component. deploying 9 workload(s) (controller-manager, controller-manager, controller-manager, controller-manager, deployment, deployment, deployment, manager, manager) with 10 container(s). watching 12 resource type(s). exposing 3 service(s) on ports: 443, 8443. with 2 webhook(s) (1 validating, 1 mutating). protected by 2 network policy/policies. connecting to external services: requests. runtime dependencies: MLflow, image-registry. with 157 operator config constants (2 image references, 27 env vars). exposing 5 Prometheus metrics. integrates with Istio, Prometheus, management relationship via labels/annotations. deploys kube-rbac-proxy sidecar for RBAC-based authorization.
